name: Open-Interest-to-Turnover Unwind Duration (cross-sectional positioning structure)
conditioning_space: positioning/liquidity information (mission Q2): OI stock relative to turnover flow (exit-capacity/duration structure)

item1_mechanism.one_paragraph: The aggregate position book of a Binance USD-M perpetual is a standing inventory that must eventually be transferred between traders. OITD measures how large that standing inventory is relative to the market's capacity to absorb its exit: D_s = notional_open_interest_s / avg_daily_dollar_turnover_s(28d) — days of typical turnover needed to unwind standing open interest (notional OI = 7-stamp trailing mean of daily OI snapshots x latest available mark price). Economic counterparty: the crowded sticky-inventory holder (slow, conviction-driven capital facing a capacity-constrained exit) versus faster arbitrage capital that can absorb the unwind. Why the edge exists: when standing inventory is large relative to daily flow, the marginal holder's exit takes many days of normal volume and is exposed to anticipatory/spiral dynamics (Brunnermeier & Pedersen 2009; Shleifer & Vishny 1997), while the accumulation already paid the good entry prices; the futures hedging-pressure literature (Bessembinder 1992; de Roon, Nijman & Veld 2000) establishes that structural positioning pressure is priced beyond beta, and OITD is the crypto-perpetual-measurable structural proxy (no COT-style hedger labels exist). Expected sign: LOW-duration symbols outperform HIGH-duration symbols over the following week; long the lowest-D tercile, short the highest-D tercile.

item2_falsifiable_prediction.passes_when: anchor after-cost expectancy > 0 AND position PF >= 1.10 AND >= 2/3 chronological folds positive; excess over BTC buy-and-hold AND over BTC-beta context positive in >= 2/3 folds; causal control fails at least one of the anchor's three gates
falsified_if_any_of: anchor fails any of the three gates (duration-crowding premium absent or sign-wrong after costs)
anchor passes but CTL-FLOW-ONLY also passes all three (edge is a pure turnover-level effect; OI stock redundant)
BTC-beta-context excess non-positive in >= 2 folds (beta repackaging)
56d neighbour contradicts anchor sign or is unstable across folds (horizon-fragile statistic)
A7-N |rho| > 0.20 vs frozen OILEV-V2 anchor OR its inverted control (voluntary novelty commitment)
item2_falsifiable_prediction.no_rescue_rule: no parameter retune, sign flip, cap change, universe carve-out or threshold relaxation may rescue any failure mode

primary_claims_used: structural positioning pressure is priced in futures markets beyond beta (L1)
positions whose exit requires many days of normal volume are exposed to anticipatory/spiral dynamics (L3)
OI data quality varies across venues; fail-closed handling required (L2, L5)
transfer_caveats: hedging-pressure premia were measured with CFTC hedger labels; Binance perps have no trader classification, so OITD is a structural proxy and the sign/oracle strength may differ
equity low-turnover premium (DNR) may exist independently of OI; the causal control arms the family against that reading
OI snapshots can be misquoted; design reads only owner-staged OI with native snapshot stamps, uses a 7-stamp mean, refuses symbols with insufficient history
24/7 instant-margin trading has no session structure; 'days of turnover to unwind' is an abstract capacity unit
one 52-week window may be regime-specific; fold and drop-one gates are the preregistered guard

item4_pit_observable.authority: fusion-record availability semantics: decision at T reads only records with available_time_utc <= T; retrieval time never substitutes (research/data_fusion/crypto_compat.py, pit.py)

records.use: daily dollar turnover = sum(close x volume) per UTC day; 90d daily closes for beta context
notional conversion of OI to USDT
COST ONLY while held; never read by any signal, ranking or eligibility rule

derived.OI7_s(T): mean of the latest 7 daily OI records with stamp <= T (stamps within trailing 10 days; fewer than 7 -> symbol ineligible, fail-closed, no back-fill)
derived.MK_s(T): latest mark record with stamp <= T (within trailing 24h; else ineligible)
derived.TO_s(T,W): sum over completed 15m bars with close stamp in (T-W, T] of close x volume, divided by W_days (anchor W=28d, neighbour W=56d); every UTC day fully covered by completed bars; gaps are failures, never filled
derived.D_s(T): OI7_s(T) * MK_s(T) / TO_s(T, 28d) — days of average turnover to unwind standing notional OI

item5_universe_warmup_clock_schedule.window: blind-S0 screen 2025-08-22T00:00:00Z..2026-08-21T00:00:00Z; warmup from authorized window (from 2024-08-20)

item5_universe_warmup_clock_schedule.folds: F0/F1/F2 chronological with 1-day purge, imported unchanged from the frozen V12 fold contract (v13_p_freeze); force-flat at fold boundaries
item5_universe_warmup_clock_schedule.execution_lag_declared_one: orders released T + 15 minutes; fill reference = OPEN price of the first completed 15m bar whose slot-open instant >= T + 15m (the 00:15Z bar; open instant coincides with order release, no look-ahead); stress +1 event delay shifts fill to the next 15m bar's open
item5_universe_warmup_clock_schedule.book_construction: rank eligible symbols by D ascending; long lowest-D tercile (6), short highest-D tercile (6), middle 7 buffer; enter on tercile entry, exit only when rank crosses beyond the median (hysteresis buffer); equal weights w = min(0.5/n_side, 0.30); n_side < 2 -> side budget to cash; side membership < 4 -> skip that stamp's rebalance, hold previous book (fail-closed); gross <= 1.0; intended holding spans >= 7d by construction

anchor.signal: D_s with 28d turnover denominator; long lowest-D tercile, short highest-D tercile

neighbour.justification: same mechanism, different justified parameter: a single burst week shifts a 28d denominator by ~25% but a 56d one by ~12%, halving estimator sensitivity; 56d warmup inside authorized window

causal_negative_control.signal: rank on 28d mean daily dollar turnover ALONE, DESCENDING (long highest-turnover tercile, short lowest-turnover tercile); OI numerator removed (constant across symbols)
causal_negative_control.justification: flow-level shadow of the anchor's mechanical exposure: for fixed OI, low D == high turnover; the control retains the turnover-level exposure and deletes the OI stock the mechanism claims is doing the work

item6_arms.preregistered_control_rule: IF anchor OITD-28D passes {after-cost expectancy > 0, position PF >= 1.10, >= 2/3 folds positive}, THEN CTL-FLOW-ONLY must fail at least one of those three gates; if CTL-FLOW-ONLY also passes all three, the edge is a pure turnover-level (flow) effect, the OI stock is redundant, and A13-V13-A8-OITD is FALSIFIED as a distinct positioning-structure mechanism
item6_arms.control_discipline: control uses no funding signal; identical clock, costs, folds and gates as the anchor

item7_incremental_test.excess_buy_and_hold: per fold f: arm_net_f - BTC_buy_and_hold_f (BTCUSDT perp, same fold window, identical force-flat convention)
item7_incremental_test.excess_btc_beta_context: per fold f: arm_net_f - beta_p * BTC_f; beta_p = trailing 90d daily regression beta of the arm's mark-to-market daily returns vs BTCUSDT daily returns (daily closes from completed 15m bars), estimated PIT at the fold's first decision stamp, held fixed over the fold
item7_incremental_test.gate: Stage-A unrelaxed: both excess series positive in >= 2/3 folds; failure of either in >= 2 folds falsifies the family's Q2 claim

item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.base_costs: frozen adapter arithmetic (GenericStrategyBase.rebalance_cost_between): taker fee bps per side + adverse tick slippage floor (tick size from instrument metadata); native funding settlements accrue exactly once per settlement inside [ts_opened, ts_closed] at the symbol's own cadence (8h/4h/1h mixed) — COST ONLY
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.stress_costs: frozen cell: fee x1.5, +2 adverse ticks, +1 event delay

cost_floors.feasibility_gate: schedule-only gate (research/v11/cost_feasibility.py) must PASS before any scoring

activity_floors.minimum_activity: arms with < 30 completed decisions refused at publication

item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.concentration: |w| <= 0.30 at every stamp by construction; gross <= 1.0; largest-symbol positive-PnL share <= 0.70 is a Stage-A outcome gate; no symbol > 25% of one-way turnover (feasibility floor)
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.drop_one: at every decision stamp drop the HELD symbol with maximum |weight| (tie-break ascending symbol name); remaining weights unchanged — no post-score renormalization; full schedule rerun; non-vacuous iff the dropped book differs from the anchor book at >= 50% of stamps with the dropped symbol held; drop-one may not flip any family verdict to PASS; reported per Stage-A gate

item9_failure_interpretation: anchor fails expectancy/PF: unwind-duration premium absent or sign-wrong after costs in this universe/window -> family falsified; no rescue, no horizon/parameter search
anchor passes, CTL-FLOW-ONLY passes too: edge is a generic turnover-level effect; OI stock adds nothing -> falsified as a positioning-structure mechanism
anchor passes, neighbour contradicts: duration statistic horizon-fragile -> not a robust mechanism; falsified
beta-context excess non-positive in >= 2 folds: BTC-beta repackaging -> not incremental; falsified for Q2
largest fold-positive share > 50%: single-regime artifact; not generalizable; falsified
feasibility floors FAIL: schedule redesign allowed pre-score only; if unachievable without weakening a frozen floor -> withdraw
drop-one vacuous: max-|w| symbol not actually held -> arm invalid, rerun refused
A7-N |rho| > 0.20 vs frozen OILEV-V2 anchor or its inverted control: INELIGIBLE under the voluntarily adopted novelty bound
signal availability < 95%: data insufficiency -> selection/BLOCKED refusal, NOT a mechanism verdict

item12_shadow_region_determination.reasoning: the mechanism is stated in its own words (exit-capacity crowding of standing inventory), never as 'the inverted anchor'; its conditioning construct (OI stock / turnover flow level) and sign region (long short-duration) are novel — none of the three measured shadow observations (inverted OI-flow +0.758; V11 LOT inversion; stocks-program vol-level sorting) involves a stock/flow duration ranking; OITD is not an inversion, rescue or renaming of any listed family (item 11); no front-door disclosure of a previously observed identical sign is claimed because no such observation exists for this construct
voluntary_disciplines: full A7-N novelty bound: |rho| > 0.20 vs the frozen OILEV-V2 anchor OR its inverted control on the common window -> INELIGIBLE and withdrawn

own causal negative control (CTL-FLOW-ONLY) separates the mechanism from the turnover-level confound; the incremental gate separates it from beta; funding is cost-only by construction, separating it from funding carry
Stage-A gates apply with no relaxation
if A7-N or A9-F nonetheless classifies this family as shadow-region, it is preregistered CONFIRMATORY and that status is recorded in the verdict and denominator, all gates unrelaxed
